original_test_intent: Verify the Serial Number of the intended SMBIOS Type 2 BaseBoard record matches the trusted board asset/manufacturing reference and persists after reboot without exposure or confusion with Type 1 system serial.
original_method: Capture all Type 2 records in protected storage, map the target board by product/version/location/BOM, extract its Serial Number, compare with the trusted board record, reboot and repeat.
manual_activity: A user supplies protected board reference/mapping and approves the plan. Protected collection, matching and reboot are automatable.
safety_requirements: Store all board serials only in approved protected evidence and do not echo them publicly.
Do not assume first Type 2 record or Type 1 system serial is the board serial.
Reject blank/placeholder/duplicate/wrong-board values and stop on exposure, drift or reboot failure.
agent_execution_scope: Collect protected all-Type-2/tool/BOM evidence, select the approved board and compare serial before/after reboot using controlled results.
Do not alter DMI, disclose identifiers or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve board record/BOM mapping, trusted reference and evidence controls.
Resolve manufacturing/asset discrepancies and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Type 2 is correct but grep can collapse multiple board records; hidden errors, insecure transport and direct serial exposure are unacceptable.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use approved transport/protected storage; archive all Type 2 records plus tool version/errors, map the board and expose only match status/evidence ID.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Type 2 script, board Serial Number scope and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Map each Type 2 record to BOM/location, compare the target board serial with its authoritative manufacturing record inside the protected evidence boundary, and verify persistence.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 2 systems, including multiple boards.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, dmidecode, BIOS and BOM revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Approved board manufacturing/asset record and evidence policy.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds multi-record provenance and identifier protection.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Board mapping, trusted serial and protected store.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: System and board serials may be different by design; only the target Type 2 record is relevant.

project_override_considerations: A project may redact displayed serials while retaining exact protected comparison; it must identify the board record and BOM.
expected_evidence: Approval, protected board reference/BOM mapping and tool version
Protected raw pre-reboot all-Type-2 records plus target comparison status
Engineer verdict without unnecessary identifier disclosure
